text.description: One clarifying question about the send time, in the language of the brief. Asking ends this call: the step waits for the answer.

options.description: Two to four short suggested answers, or null for a free answer.

question.description: Set only when the brief is genuinely ambiguous about the send time and questions_left is above 0; then entries and summary are null.

anyOf.description: Exactly one entry for each locale (language and timezone pair) of the input, in the order of the input.

language.description: A language code copied unchanged from the input locale.

timezone.description: The IANA time zone copied unchanged from the same input locale, for example Europe/Istanbul.

send_at.description: RFC 3339 date and time with an explicit offset, for example 2026-11-02T10:00:00+03:00, in the time zone of the locale; null to send immediately.

rationale.description: One short sentence, in the language of the brief, saying where the time comes from.

entries.description: The schedule; null only when question is set.

summary.description: With entries: two to four sentences for the marketer, in the language of the brief, in markdown (lists and bold allowed; no links, no HTML, no headings), saying when each locale is sent and why. Null only when question is set.
